# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_RIBBON_EXPANSION_BREAK_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A sudden expansion of the EMA ribbon after a period of compression signals a short-lived momentum burst that tends to revert. We aim to capture the mean reversion after an overextended move by entering short when the ribbon width expands beyond a threshold, price is above VWAP, RSI is high, and time is midday, expecting a reversion to the mean.

## Mechanism

Entry: When ribbon width (EMA55 - EMA8) expands to > 2 * its 20-period average width, price is > 1 * ATR above VWAP, RSI(14) > 60, and time is between 11:30-13:30 ET, enter short at the close of the bar.  
Exit:  
- Chart-stop at the most recent swing high (HH)  
- TP1 at 1R (risk-reward of 1)  
- Runner trail using a chandelier exit (ATR * 3)  
Regime hint: Only consider when VIX is between 15-25 and price is near VWAP (|price-VWAP| < 0.2*ATR) indicating a neutral trend before the expansion.
